content: If the data element DEM_AGINGCTR_DOWNCNT is configured, the aging counter mapping shall be based on a count-down mechanism from DemAg- ingCycleCounterThreshold to 0 (refer to ISO-14229-1[2], Annex D).

If the data element DEM_AGINGCTR_DOWNCNT is configured, the aging counter mapping shall be based on a count-down mechanism from DemAg- ingCycleCounterThreshold to 0 (refer to ISO-14229-1[2], Annex D).

If the DemAgingCycleCounterThreshold is configured, then the value of the data element DEM_AGINGCTR_DOWNCNT shall be based on a count- down mechanism from DemAgingCycleCounterThreshold to 0 (refer to ISO- 14229-1[2], Annex D).
